title: Fantastic tour with Jorge Gershon
text: Jorge Gershon was an excellent guide. He is extremely knowledgeable and we learned so much on this fascinating tour. I would highly recommend to anyone coming to Seville and wanting to learn more about the Jewish history.
author: Mandstrips

title: Seville guided tour.
text: Jorge was truly great. He was informative, passionate, engaging and very knowledgeable. We would highly recommend his tour.
author: robertjU4214XV
